idea-plugin.name: budi
idea-plugin.description:
budi shows your AI coding spend in the IDE status bar — last 1d / 7d / 30d, mirroring the Claude Code statusline.

Sibling of the budi-cursor extension for VS Code and Cursor. Reads from the local budi daemon on 127.0.0.1:7878; if the daemon is missing, the plugin guides you through the install. JetBrains-rooted Copilot Chat usage is tracked under the jetbrains surface so the cloud dashboard can break costs down by editor host.
